title: 零售电商负责人Retail E-commerce Lead

description.text: JOB SUMMARY As the Retail E-commerce Lead, you will be fully responsible for business development and operational management of the retail products on third-party online e-commerce platforms. You will lead and inspire your team to deeply exploit the potential of these channels, driving business growth and innovation through strategic partnerships with established platforms and emerging channels. This role demands exceptional capabilities in strategic planning, team leadership, resource integration, and data analysis to enhance brand value, product accessibility, and patient services, while ensuring all operational activities strictly comply with corporate standards. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategy & Business Planning: Responsible for setting sales targets and formulating operational strategies for retail products on e-commerce channels. Lead the development of annual/quarterly online marketing plans and monthly sales plans based on market insights and internal business analysis. Coordinate key partners, including supply chain, finance, and marketing, to clarify budget and resource allocation, ensuring the achievement of sales objectives. Channel Expansion & Innovation: Drive strategic partnerships with major e-commerce platforms and emerging channels such as health/private clinics/medical aesthetics. Explore and develop innovative business models to expand channel breadth and depth, generating incremental business growth. Team Leadership & Performance Management: Lead, develop, and mentor the team. Set clear goals, provide coaching and training, unlock the team's potential, and ensure efficient operation and achievement of performance targets. Retail Brand & Product Operation: Continuously enhance the online brand image and product competitiveness. Increase market share through optimized product portfolio management, potential product exploration, and refined operational tactics. Data-Driven Insights & Market Intelligence: Conduct in-depth analysis of channel operation data, monitor campaign effectiveness and expenses to ensure ROI. Collect and synthesize market and competitor intelligence to generate insightful reports that support business decision-making and innovation. Key Project Management: Oversee end-to-end project management for critical large-scale platform campaigns, including planning, launch, execution, and post-campaign review. Internal & External Collaboration: Maintain and strengthen strategic relationships with key platform partners, securing premium resources. Effectively coordinate with internal cross-functional teams to ensure seamless online operations and strict adherence to all company policies and industry regulations. Integrity & Compliance: Ensure all online operational activities strictly comply with company compliance policies, industry guidelines, and relevant laws and regulations. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor's degree or above; a major in Marketing, Medicine, or a related field is preferred. Minimum of 10 years of experience on the pharmaceutical/healthcare and internet industry, with at least 5 years in e-commerce platform operation management and proven team leadership experience. Demonstrated success in online channel expansion and operation for pharmaceutical products or health-related consumer goods, with deep knowledge and practical experience on platforms like JD.com, Alibaba, and Meituan. Outstanding brand marketing planning skills, market insight, and strategic thinking. Strong project management and overall planning capabilities, with the ability to forecast and manage project risks. Understanding of relevant laws, regulations, compliance requirements, and management specifications within the pharmaceutical industry. Exceptional leadership skills with experience in managing and developing high-performing teams. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Chinese and English, with strong presentation and facilitation abilities. Exceptional interpersonal, influencing, and relationship-building skills. Strong achievement motivation, excellent execution, planning, and time management skills. Superior communication and coordination skills, ability to work under pressure, and adaptability to a rapidly changing environment. Proven ability to drive breakthrough innovation and effectively integrate resources to achieve objectives. INTEGRITY Manage all activities in strict accordance with company policies, industry guidelines, and relevant laws. Uphold the highest standards of integrity, truthfulness, and transparency, with a clean record free of legal or regulatory violations. FOR INTERNAL APPLICANTS Internal applicants must comply with the standard compliance investigation process, not be subject to any performance improvement plans or compliance violations and meet other stipulated requirements. Job Summary: 负责部分零售品牌在第三方电商平台的（ B2C ）的品牌活动设计及监督执行，及相关平台整体运营，并通过合作深度挖掘电商平台价值，支持业务的需求，实现业务创新；通过电商平台的能力强化辉瑞品牌价值，提升药品可及性，优化患者服务；协调内外部资源，合理规划运营方案，确保投入产出合理性；洞察行业和市场变化，清晰运营数据， 布局医药电商合作生态 。 Responsibilities: 负责对应零售品牌在第三方电商平台的销售目标制定与销售运营：依据品牌的销售策略制定线上营销策略，结合市场分析与自身分析，主导制定线上运营策略并主导与制订月度的销售计划，能够协调调动关键资源（如供应链、资金、公司内部配合等）并明确预算、资源分配，能够针对市场变化及时做出灵活的反应，确保销售目标的达成； 负责对应第三方电商平台的管理跟进，深度挖掘电商平台可以提供的平台价值，能够通过外部电商平台的合作及其关联资源的能力更多支持业务需求，把握网络市场的整体趋势和发展动向，完成创新相关的电商平台的策略和执行，例如医生教育、患者教育、患者管理、创新支付等。 负责对应电商渠道产品价值链观察，并上报公司，使公司能够得到准确的市场信息及执行情况； 负责对应电商平台活动有效性评估及推广费用的分析，费用控制在预算内 负责完成对应电商平台的数据分析和整理，及时跟进和反馈数据，收集、整理相关市场信息，包括平台动态、竞争动态等，进行有效分析并整理成相应格式的汇报文档，为公司业务创新开拓提供平台和数据支持； 负责重要大型平台活动的项目管理：主导大型平台活动的项目（包含618、双11、疾病日等）启动，计划管理，项目总结； 洞察行业和市场变化，通过电商平台能力产生创新的解决方案，应对突发事件，并能够快速落地执行和持续跟进； 负责电商平台的关系维护：负责平台运营沟通与关系维护，争取平台资源，更好促进辉瑞与平台的合作与发展； 负责协调相关内部各团队，支持完成电商运营所需的内部资源整合和完成内部流程，确保电商运营合规性； 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作； Education and Experience: 本科及以上学历，市场营销及医药相关专业优先； 3年以上电商运营经验，5-10年以上互联网或医药行业工作经验； 强执行力，能够快速反应快速执行； 具有良好的品牌营销策划能力和市场洞察能力， 具备较强的项目运营能力和统筹能力，能够预知风险并管理项目风险； 精通熟悉医药类网站、专题策划、网络推广及运营工作方法 了解医药行业相关管理法律法规、合规要求和管理规范； 敢于突破，勇于创新，并能不懈努力，整合多方资源和方法实现目标； 具备强烈的成就动机、较强的执行力、良好的计划和时间管理能力； 具备良好的沟通技巧，能承担压力； 较强的市场洞察能力、对新知识、技术和工具有热情，能快速适应变化。 Technical Skills Requirements: 有出色的口头和书面沟通能力以及演讲和引导技巧 有英文读写能力和口语表达能力； 强大的人际交往能力和影响力，以及沟通技巧 能通过技术解决方案来管理项目，包括适当的 Microsoft Office 程序（即 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Project、Visio）和 SharePoint。 Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates. Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, the impact you will have on improving patients' lives is profound. You will play a pivotal role in transforming the way we launch our products, ensuring they reach patients faster and with greater impact. Through the power of our seven portfolios, we have an unparalleled opportunity to learn faster, act quicker, and be bolder. Whether you are responsible for leading commercial strategies or supporting the development and implementation, your role can transform the way we launch our products to get them into the hands of patients faster and with more impact. What You Will Achieve In this role, you will: Lead and provide guidance on moderately complex projects, managing time and resources effectively. Apply skills and discipline knowledge to contribute to departmental work, making decisions to resolve moderately complex problems and developing new options in non-standard situations. Work independently on assignments, seeking guidance on unusual or complex problems, and review your own work while mentoring others. Utilize business and analytical skills to enhance financial, resource, and portfolio data, driving improved business decision-making. Oversee financial and resource analytics, creating dashboards for actionable insights, and offering recommendations and actions. Guide operational teams in project management, forecast resource requirements, and identify areas for improvement in products, processes, or services. Foster a culture of innovation, support vendor oversight activities, and oversee key metrics and quality measures. Serve as the operational support lead for cross-functional partners, collaborating with internal teams to enhance user engagement and optimize customer experience. Facilitate team communication, implement best practices, improve service delivery with delivery partners, and develop digital channels with local business units. Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements) BA/BS with at least 4 years of experience or MBA/MS with at least 2 years of experience or PhD/JD with any years of experience or associate's degree with at least 8 years of experience or high school diploma (or equivalent) with at least 10 years of relevant experience Proven ability to drive execution of strategies, training design, and delivery experience in the pharmaceutical industry Proficient in project management skills Market business acumen and ability to lead innovation Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize Excellent command of both written and spoken English Proficiency in utilizing MS Office Applications Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements): Master's degree with substantial experience in commercial operations, sales, and marketing Demonstrated leadership in promoted positions, including people leadership and developmental roles, showcasing leadership across peer and manager groups Knowledge of Structured Query Language Experience with digital marketing and customer engagement strategies Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support problem solving and enhance productivity. Demonstrated curiosity for exploring how these tools can improve outcomes and understanding of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use      Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
